profile.headline: Software Engineer & Ph.D.
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer and Technical Leader with 10+ years of experience spanning software engineering, technical leadership, research, and instruction. Proven track record of building large-scale cloud and distributed systems, leading high-impact initiatives, and mentoring engineering teams. Recognized with 1st place in a Microsoft coding competition and holder of IBM certifications. Passionate about advancing software and computer engineering through continuous learning, innovation, and technical excellence.

positions.description:
- Working on backend services @Microsoft Teams Events
- Worked on backend services @Microsoft Mesh

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Java-script and Web-assembly engine for Chromium-based browser.
Break the internet more than once and make it faster and better more than twice :)

@v8: 
- Optimize frozen/sealed object by 6 times, proxy traps by 50%, number to string by 75%, exponentiation operator by 10 times, etc.
- Refactor code: Torquefy class definition, string builtins.
- Fix security bugs, test262.
- Web assembly debugging: support break points and stepping in WAT, 

@Chakra: 
- Implement ES BigInt foundation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
Software Engineer
Graduate Research/ Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Worked under the supervision of Professor Thinh Nguyen. My research interests are broad and not limited on the area of: Randomized Optimization, Distributed Computing, Mixing Time, Network Coding.

- Teaching assistant for: ECE 351 - Signals & Systems I (Fall 2013); ECE 353 - Introduction to probabilities & random signals (Winter 2014, Spring 2014); ECE 560: Stochastic Signals and Systems (Winter 2015).

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Learned Big Data @Ads Optimization & Audience
- Implemented and integrated an end-to-end module into existing user targeting systems to automatically collect and classify mobile apps info, improving mobile app categorization coverage by 40% and increasing request coverage by 200 millions. 
- Tech stack included Clojure, Cascalog, Hadoop, Map-Reduce, Impala, and Avro.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Launched full-stack web services to provide live Abu Dhabi, UAE traffic status, within just one month of the internship. Subsequently, Toyota and Nokia were in discussion to purchase these services I made to use in their apps. Tech stack included Java (Servlets), PostgreSQL, and Tomcat server.
- Implemented end-to-end Quality Control Manager (QCM) function module into existing traffic predictions systems which automated the QC process and saved the company from allocating a full-time engineer to perform this task manually.
- Implemented a data retaining feature which improves existing heavy traffic emulations by 20% in performance.
- Integrated traffic status predictions into Maps to effectively detect live traffic problems, using GMap.NET, C# (Windows Forms), and MySQL.

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
@School of Information & Communication Technology
- Instructed and prepared syllabus for class of 50-100 students in 4 courses. Provided a full-stack CS knowledge: Assembly Language and Computer Architecture (low-end), C Programming (middle-end), Web Design (high-end), and Project Management for Embedded Systems (soft skills). 
- Mentored 6 undergraduate CS research projects, one of which (Traffic-based Social Network) was in top 10 projects in Microsoft Imagine Cup 2011, Vietnam.
- Served as Organizing Committee for Student Research in 17th ICT Conference Magazine Proceeding, SOICT, HUST. ISBN: 978-604-911-001-6, May 2010.
- Researched in Collaboration Center for Research and Development of Satellite Navigation Technology in South-East Asia related to SEAGAL, funded by the European Union under the European Commission's Seventh Research Framework program and coordinated by NavSAS.

company.name: Hanoi University of Science and Technology

positions.title: Technical Leader
positions.description:
- Leaded a team of 10 developers to launch the first website in Vietnam, a part of the grand effort to encourage/train blind/disabled people to access the internet. 
- Designed and implemented full stack using ASP.NET, DotNetNuke. Improved the site accessibility using WCAG 2.0. 
- The site motivated 1000 regular users, including first-time blind people, volunteers, donors, sponsors. 
- Award received: Second-prize Microsoft Imagine Cup - Vietnam 2008, Golden Globe award in ICT - Vietnam 2009, For Community award - Vietnam 2010. Link: tamhonvietnam.net
*The project is sponsored by the Vietnamese Ministry of Information & Communications.

projects.title: Development of a Security-Consicous Distributed Email System
projects.description:
A security-conscious email system was developed in Java to provide enhanced privacy and ensure maximum up-time by opting for a distributed architecture rather that the traditional client-server model that is used by most existing email systems. The proposed design also reduces hard drive consumption by eliminating the need to store copies of all emails on all network participants. 
Keywords: BitMessage, I2P, I2P-Bote, Distributed Hash Table, Onion Routing.

projects.title: Solutions for Project Euler.net
projects.description:
- Solved a number of challenging mathematical/computer programming problems.
- Used Java, C/C++.
- Link: https://github.com/duongnhn/Euler

patents.title: Systems and methods for generating passwords
patents.description: The disclosed computer-implemented method for generating passwords may include (i) accessing a vault of confidential information describing a user, (ii) extracting, from the vault, a set of multiple items of confidential information describing the user, (iii) executing a programmed heuristic on the set of multiple items of confidential information to generate multiple candidate passwords that each derives from a respective semirandom permutation of the multiple items of confidential information, and (iv) displaying electronically the multiple candidate passwords to the user to enable the user to select a password from the multiple candidate passwords as a specific password for accessing a protected computing resource. Various other methods, systems, and computer-readable media are also disclosed.
